Small placeholder files for model scanner tests. These are not usable model weights.

external_sdxl_workflow.json is a reduced external UI graph fixture for parser tests. Its node/link serialization is based on the Comfy-Org SDXL template: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/sdxl_simple_example.json

comfy_org_sdxl_simple_full.json is the complete Comfy-Org SDXL simple example template downloaded on 2026-09-29 for full-workflow preservation and API-conversion tests: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/sdxl_simple_example.json
